verdict.rationale: There is no documented export feature. The only route out is indirect: an open API with a published OpenAPI spec, list endpoints such as listing received emails and retrieving broadcast clicks, and an official CLI and MCP server. Users could script their own data extraction with these, and templates built in React Email are portable code. Missing for 10: a documented full-account or contact export, defined open export formats (CSV/JSON dumps), outbound migration or offboarding guidance, and any independent confirmation that a complete data export works.
